notes.title: Early Access Released!
notes.content:
Early Access is released! We will update daily until the official release!
The beginning of early access will be very simple, with only one singleplayer mode for testing, but every week new modes and maps will be released.[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2151820/Zombie_Arena/][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/934870579100680273/1030604972066340874/AVAILABLE_NOW.png[/img][/url]
